interpretation.ram_vram: Likely a modest reduction because the site is procedural and has no imported model payload; exact RAM and VRAM delta is unknown without a controlled live A/B.
interpretation.rendering: Potentially useful draw-call and shadow-work reduction whenever the former mall would be in or near the camera frustum; exact calls vary by view and renderer state.
interpretation.dominant_runtime_cost: Kira's active avatar/model, mind services, browser, and other world systems are expected to dominate over this legacy procedural block, but that expectation was not promoted to a measured result.

method.reason_live_ab_not_run: The requested work was safe static planning and code verification while the shell was inactive; unrelated existing browser processes would also prevent a clean process-memory comparison.
